$comment: Every third-party image BylineCRM's CI, Dockerfiles and deployments run (#123). mirror-images.yml copies each source@digest byte-for-byte to ghcr.io/muneebgawri/mirror/<name>:<tag>, so the mirror's digest IS the upstream digest. Everything references ghcr.io/muneebgawri/mirror/<name>@<digest>; scripts/check-image-refs.mjs fails CI on any other image reference or a digest not listed here. To bump: change tag and digest here, change the same digest at every reference the check lists, push — mirror-images.yml copies it on that push. docs/deploy/images.md.
